area.description: Subsystem or area, e.g. gate, docs, deploy.

evidence.description: Filled by pass-gate.py verify on success, or by a logged human override. Empty (null) evidence must never accompany status=passing.

command.description: The verification command that was actually run. Must equal verification.command unless this is an override.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the run. Must be 0 for status=passing, unless overridden (see override). -1 means no passing run: a human override (evidence.override present).

output_tail.description: Last lines of the verification output (truncated to ~2 KB), so a reviewer can see what passed without re-running.

override.description: Present only when a human explicitly overrode a failing/unguarded check. The override is also appended to gate/events.jsonl.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of output_tail, so a reviewer can detect tampered evidence. Written by pass-gate.py verify/terminate; absent on human overrides.

external_evidence.description: Verification artifacts imported from an external runtime (e.g. Comet) via gate/comet_adapter.py. Informational only: it never changes status - passing still requires pass-gate.py to execute the item's own verification command.

id.description: Unique, stable, lowercase-hyphen id. Referenced by SESSION_STATE.md and events.jsonl.

priority.description: p0 = must land first, p1 = this phase, p2 = nice to have.

status.description: Allowed transitions: not_started -> in_progress -> passing; in_progress -> blocked -> in_progress; passing -> in_progress only via an explicit, reasoned reopen (pass-gate.py reopen). Direct edits to this field are blocked by the PreToolUse hook (Claude Code only); use pass-gate.py.

user_visible_behavior.description: What a user (or the next session) can observe when this is done. No behaviour, no item.

command.description: Executable command (shell) that proves the item. Must be runnable in the project root. Exit 0 = pass.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for the verification command. Default 300.

description: Machine-readable feature list / state machine for the agent-harness gate layer (Phase 1). Statuses: not_started / in_progress / blocked / passing. At most one item may be in_progress at a time (WIP=1). An item may enter `passing` only with non-empty evidence produced by running its verification command (or a logged human override). `passing` is irreversible except through an explicit, reasoned reopen, which is recorded in gate/events.jsonl. This schema is validated by gate/pass-gate.py (stdlib only) and by tests/repo_checks.py §3k; the two validators must agree on the subset they enforce (required fields, enums, types, WIP=1, evidence-required-for-passing).

project.description: Project name this list belongs to.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only with a written decision in DECISIONS.md.

title: feature_list
